summary: Unplanned routing to memory-optimized replica causes KV-cache coldstart spikes and request timeouts
description:
Issue summary: Starting 2026-03-12 09:14 UTC, FinLedger reported sustained p95/p99 latency degradation and 504 timeouts for inference requests routed to rw-gpt-7b on their dedicated pool. Root cause appears to be the router selecting a memory-optimized replica variant (mem-8x) as a fallback during transient GPU allocation pressure. The mem-8x variant does not have a warmed KV/prefix cache for this workload and executes a cold-path that amplifies latency (KV misses + large memory paging).

Impact: Customer-facing production API for FinLedger experienced elevated p99 (12–22s) and ~3% 504 rate for ~45 minutes. This affected several downstream batch jobs and triggered an incident for a financial reporting job. The customer reported business impact (missed SLA for end-of-day reporting).

Environment: Dedicated tenant: finledger-ded-01. Region: us-east-1. Model manifest pinned to rw-gpt-7b:v2026-03-08. Fallback policy: weight-ranked variants [gpu-fast, cpu-fallback, mem-8x]. Autoscaler observed a transient shortage of GPU replicas at 09:12 UTC and initiated routing decisions at 09:13 UTC.

Observed behaviour: Requests were rerouted from gpu-fast to mem-8x (memory-optimized) instead of cpu-fallback or quantized variants. mem-8x replicas had not completed KV prewarm and were still initializing large attention-key caches. Router's decision model favored mem-8x because of 'capacity headroom' scoring (available RAM > threshold) and a stale topology state returned by the placement service. The result was repeated cold KV fetches and occasional OS-level paging observed on the replica nodes, extending tail latency and causing request timeouts.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Use a dedicated tenant with pinned model rw-gpt-7b and fallback policy containing gpu-fast, cpu-fallback, mem-8x variants.
2) Induce GPU pressure on the pool (simulate sudden scale up/down or schedule a large batch run) so router sees transient shortage.
3) Observe routing decisions in the smart-routing logs that prefer mem-8x when placement service reports delayed GPU allocation data.
4) Send a steady stream of inference requests with long prefixes to exacerbate KV misses and observe p99 latency and 504 rate increase.
logs: 2026-03-12T09:13:10Z mem-8x[warn] replica_id=mem-8x-3 kv_cache=miss rate=0.87 paging=high rss=45GB
investigation_notes: Initial triage: Support confirmed customer traffic patterns and times. CS gathered request ids and latency graphs from Console.

SRE review: Placement service returned 'stale' topology snapshot during the GPU shortage window. Router's fallback scoring currently prioritizes variants by available compute headroom and a static cost heuristic; it does not penalize variants with 'cold KV' state.

Hypothesis: Router prefers mem-8x due to higher reported memory headroom and lower cost score; however mem-8x lacks warmed KV prefix for FinLedger's common prefixes causing repeated KV retrievals from slow backing store + OS-level page-ins, leading to long tail latencies.
Confirmed that mem-8x replicas had recently been provisioned (boot time ~4m prior) and prewarm job queued but incomplete. Prewarm queue backed up due to concurrent warmups in same rack.
Observed autoscaler actions overlapped with canary rollouts for another customer which temporarily inflated placement latency metrics.

resolution:
Mitigation applied (2026-03-12 12:18 UTC): Updated FinLedger's routing policy to set 'fallback_preference' to prefer cpu-fallback and quantized variants over memory-optimized mem-8x, and temporarily disabled mem-8x in their tenant config. This immediately reduced p99 to <1s and 504s to 0.
Permanent fixes planned: 1) Enhance smart-router scoring to include 'kv_warmth' and 'recent_boot' penalties so freshly provisioned replicas are deprioritized unless prewarm complete. 2) Add prewarm backpressure and prioritization for dedicated tenants to avoid queue starvation. 3) Placement service improvement to reduce stale topology windows (INT-4123). 4) Instrument a coldstart circuit-breaker that prevents routing >X% traffic to replicas with <Y% KV hit rate.
Follow-ups: PRs and rollout timeline created (see related_github_prs). Postmortem scheduled and to be linked to this ticket. Customer success to provide incident writeup to FinLedger.
workarounds: 1) For affected tenant, set fallback_preference to avoid mem-8x variants until prewarm completes.
2) Pin to an earlier model variant with warmed replicas (if acceptable), or enable conservative autoscaling thresholds to avoid placing new mem-heavy replicas under load spikes.
3) Manually trigger prewarm for mem-8x replicas when planned capacity changes are expected.
